incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (Joint-Stock Companies, Partnerships Limited by Shares, Limited Liability Companies and Partnerships), Articles 102-115 governing Limited Liability Company formation; complemented by Investment Law No. 72 of 2017 and its Executive Regulations, and Law No. 15 of 2017 on Industrial Licensing for the subsequent operating permit.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) - One-Stop Shop (OSS); Commercial Registry service window of the Ministry of Supply and Internal Trade, co-located at the GAFI One-Stop Shop for LLC registration.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Request for Incorporation of a Limited Liability Company (GAFI Form LLC-1) together with the Notarized Memorandum of Association and the Articles of Association, filed electronically and physically through the GAFI One-Stop Shop.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: Under Law No. 159 of 1981, the statutory minimum capital of an LLC is EGP 1,000, with the actual capital set by the founding members in the Memorandum of Association. The entire issued capital must be subscribed by the founders, and not less than 50% of the aggregate cash capital must be deposited into a temporary escrow bank account opened in the name of the company under incorporation. The bank deposit certificate accompanies the GAFI file, and the escrow balance converts to the corporate account immediately after the Certificate of Incorporation is issued.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: At the inaugural meeting of [COMPANY NAME] LLC held on [DATE], the founding members, acting as the first general assembly, unanimously resolved: 1. The subscription schedule attached to the Memorandum of Association is ratified; the entire capital is subscribed and the statutory escrow deposit of 50% is verified. 2. The registered office at [ADDRESS], Egypt, is adopted; management shall file the address with GAFI and the Commercial Registry. 3. [NAME] is appointed General Manager, [NAME] Finance Officer, and [NAME] Company Secretary, each acting within delegated authority. Management is authorized to complete tax, banking, social insurance, and industrial licensing filings. All resolutions are effective immediately. Passed unanimously.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop - Company Name Reservation desk (e-forms portal and physical OSS window)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit three proposed Arabic and English company names ranked by preference, with the descriptor LLC included. The OSS verifies each candidate against the unified Commercial Registry database, rejects identical or deceptively similar names, reserves one approved name for 90 days, and issues a Name Reservation Certificate to be attached to the incorporation file.
required_dossiers: Company Name Reservation Application (Form Name-1)
Certified copy of national ID or passport of each founding member
Power of attorney where the application is submitted by an agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused for similarity or defective Arabic construction, corrected alternative names may be resubmitted within 15 days without a substantive fee. A written grievance may be lodged with the GAFI name-review committee, which must issue a decision within 10 business days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Notarization of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian corporate attorney (draftsman) and the Notary Public Office of the Ministry of Justice (Tawthiq - Notary General)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a licensed attorney to prepare the Arabic Memorandum and Articles of Association in compliance with Articles 102-115 of Law 159/1981, covering the capital, quota division, management powers, registered office, and an objects clause limited to the manufacture of hard enamel lapel pins and novelty metal badges. All founding members execute the instrument in person or through a notarized power of attorney; the deed is then attested at the Notary Public Office, which collects stamp duty and certifies the execution.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum and Articles of Association
Certificate of Company Name Reservation
Certified copies of founders' identity documents
Duly effected powers of attorney for any absent founder
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the notary records a formal defect, such as an incomplete capital clause or a missing signature page, the attorney corrects the deed and re-attests it before the same notary within 5 business days. Material corrections require re-execution by all founding members and a fresh attestation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening of the Temporary Escrow Account and Deposit of 50% of Subscribed Capital
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Egyptian commercial bank branch regulated by the Central Bank of Egypt accepting capital-under-incorporation accounts
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the draft Memorandum of Association and founders' documents to the selected bank, open the temporary account in the name of the company under incorporation, and deposit at least 50% of the aggregate cash capital committed in the Memorandum. The bank issues a Capital Deposit Certificate with an official statement stamp, which is attached to the GAFI filing. The funds remain blocked until the Certificate of Incorporation is presented to the bank.
required_dossiers: Draft Memorandum of Association
National ID or passport of each founding member
Certificate of Company Name Reservation
Bank KYC forms and beneficial ownership declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank applies enhanced due diligence or suspends part of the deposit, the founding members must supply source-of-funds evidence and the beneficial ownership declaration. If GAFI ultimately refuses incorporation, the escrow is returned to the payors upon presentation of the GAFI written refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: GAFI One-Stop-Shop Incorporation Filing, Certificate of Incorporation, Commercial Registry and Tax Card
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: GAFI One-Stop Shop (OSS) at the Egypt Investor Center, with integrated Commercial Registry and Egyptian Tax Authority service windows
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File Form LLC-1 together with the notarized Memorandum, escrow deposit certificate, name reservation certificate, founders' identity documents, and proof of the registered office address. Pay the statutory filing and registration fees of approximately USD 250 equivalent in Egyptian pounds. The OSS issues the Certificate of Incorporation, registers the LLC in the Commercial Registry, obtains the Tax Identification Number and Tax Card from the Egyptian Tax Authority, and publishes the legal summary in the electronic Commercial Gazette.
required_dossiers: Form LLC-1 Incorporation Application
Notarized Memorandum and Articles of Association
Capital Deposit Certificate issued by the escrow bank
Certificate of Company Name Reservation
Certified copies of founders' national IDs or passports
Fiscal identity data of each founding member
Rental contract or title deed evidencing the registered office address
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the OSS issues a completeness notice, the applicant must cure the defects within 10 business days. In the event of refusal, a grievance may be filed with GAFI within 30 days, or the file may be resubmitted once without an additional substantive fee after curing the stated defect.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Incorporation Activation: VAT Registration, Corporate Bank Account Conversion, Social Insurance and Labor Declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) VAT registration desk and EgyptIn e-service portal; escrow bank branch; National Organization for Social Insurance (NOSI); Ministry of Labor local office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Present the Certificate of Incorporation to the escrow bank to convert the temporary account into the final corporate account and release the deposit. Register for VAT with the ETA where taxable turnover reaches or exceeds the EGP 500,000 annual threshold under Law No. 67 of 2016, with voluntary registration recommended to preserve input VAT credits. Register the LLC and all employees with NOSI within 30 days of first hiring, and file the workplace declaration with the Ministry of Labor.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation
Commercial Registry extract
Tax Card issued at Step 4
Memorandum and Articles of Association
Lease contract of the registered office
Founders' and officers' identity documents
VAT Application Form No. 050 (ETA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: For VAT classification or threshold disputes, submit a corrective declaration with turnover evidence to the ETA taxing directorate. If NOSI assesses late-registration penalties, present the incorporation date and payroll records and file a penalty mitigation request under the applicable amnesty and settlement procedures.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial License, Environmental Screening and Civil-Defense Pre-Operation Clearances
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) - Industrial Licensing Administration under Law No. 15 of 2017; Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA); Civil Defense Directorate of the Ministry of Interior
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: File the industrial license application with IDA for the hard enamel lapel pin production facility, electing the fast-track route for low-risk light manufacturing. Simultaneously submit the environmental classification and screening form to the EEAA for Category B determination, and obtain the Civil Defense fire-safety certificate and structural load clearance for the leased production space. The industrial operating license must be secured before commercial production begins.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation and Commercial Registry extract
Lease contract or title deed of the factory premises
IDA industrial license application with site layout and equipment list
EEAA environmental screening form (Category B)
Civil Defense fire-safety inspection report
Occupational health and safety plan
Fire and third-party liability insurance policy
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If IDA issues a conditional license, satisfy each pre-operating condition within 90 days and apply for final license issuance. If the application is rejected or lapses, appeal in writing to the IDA Grievance Committee within 60 days of notification, while completing corrective measures such as fire protection upgrades and requesting re-inspection at any time.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Industrial Development Authority (IDA) - Industrial Licensing Administration, Ministry of Trade and Industry, administering Law No. 15 of 2017 on Industrial Licensing and its Executive Regulations
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Industrial Operating License for the Manufacture of Hard Enamel Lapel Pins (Die-Struck Brass Cloisonne Novelty Badges) under the simplified low-risk licensing track of Law No. 15 of 2017

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Egyptian Environmental Affairs Agency (EEAA), Ministry of Environment, implementing Law No. 4 of 1994 on Environmental Protection and its Executive Regulations (Decree No. 338 of 1995, as amended)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category B - Limited Environmental Assessment: the facility submits the screening form and an Environmental Management Plan. If the production line adds full electroplating or cyanide baths, or annual discharges exceed the small-workshop thresholds, the project is reclassified as Category A requiring a full Environmental Impact Assessment study approved before operation.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Wastewater: no direct discharge without an EEAA permit; where connected to municipal sewer, compliance with Ministerial Decree No. 44 of 2000 limits, including pH 6-9, BOD5 not exceeding 60 mg/L, COD not exceeding 80 mg/L, TSS not exceeding 60 mg/L, lead not exceeding 0.5 mg/L, nickel not exceeding 1.0 mg/L, copper not exceeding 1.5 mg/L, and cyanide not exceeding 0.05 mg/L. Air: VOC emissions from enamel baking ovens and degreasing baths must comply with Decree No. 44 of 2000 threshold values and applicable Egyptian Occupational Exposure Limits; polishing dust controlled by local exhaust ventilation. Hazardous waste, including spent enamel residues, degreasing solutions and polishing sludge, must be stored in labeled leak-proof containers and transferred only to EEAA-licensed carriers under a written waste manifest.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Civil Defense Fire-Safety Certificate from the Ministry of Interior confirming fire extinguishers, emergency exits, electrical grounding and egress pathways; structural load inspection certificate issued by a certified engineer validating the flooring and mezzanine against machine and storage loads; Ministry of Labor occupational health clearance with first-aid provisions and employee safety training records; all certificates renewed annually and presented to the Industrial Development Authority before the final industrial operating license is issued.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA), official portal https://www.eta.gov.eg/
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities register for Tax Identification Number (TIN) with the Egyptian Tax Authority by submitting an application via the ETA portal or in-person at authorized offices, including commercial registration certificate, ownership documents, and proof of address. Approval is typically issued within 7-14 business days.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box elections available; entity classification is determined by legal form under Egyptian law. Hybrid mismatch elections are not applicable.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory real-time electronic invoicing and fiscal clearance through the ETA's integrated digital system with API connectivity and automated digital stamping for all transactions.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT rate applies to exports of goods and offshore services. Eligibility is substantiated by customs export declaration and proof of foreign currency repatriation.
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent claims result in retrospective tax assessments, penalties of 200% of evaded tax, interest surcharges, and potential criminal prosecution.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Egypt (CBE), acting under the Central Bank and Banking System Law No. 194 of 2020, the Foreign Exchange Regulations and related circulars issued by the CBE's Foreign Exchange and Bank Supervision Departments, in coordination with the General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) and the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit (EMCLU).
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Egypt operates a unified, market-driven floating exchange-rate regime following the CBE's 6 March 2024 liberalization, under which the EGP/USD rate is determined by interbank supply and demand. Current-account transactions (export proceeds, import payments, service fees, royalties) are freely convertible for bona fide commercial purposes through CBE-licensed banks, subject to underlying document verification (commercial invoice, customs declaration Form 4, contract/PO). Capital-account transactions (foreign equity injection, FDI repatriation, shareholder loans, dividend remittances) are permitted but require strict documentary compliance: GAFI registration, audited financial statements, settlement of corporate tax liabilities, board/shareholder resolutions, and the CBE's economic-status codes. Profit remittance for an LLC is lawful but practically conditioned on obtaining a tax clearance certificate from the Egyptian Tax Authority and a no-objection from the dealing bank. No dual exchange rate or generalized convertibility moratorium is currently in force; however, banks may sequence FX availability according to interbank liquidity, so treasury planning must maintain a 2–4-week buffer for EGP conversion of large USD amounts.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Egyptian exporters must repatriate 100% of export proceeds through a CBE-licensed bank in Egypt within a statutory maximum of 4 months from the date of shipment for manufactured goods (hard enamel lapel pins under HS 7326/7117 or similar), extendable to a maximum of 8 months with the assigned bank's approval in cases of open-account receivables or verified buyer delays. As of the March 2024 exchange-rate unification, the earlier mandatory surrender/conversion ratios (50%–100% of export receipts converted to EGP) have been abolished; the LLC may retain 100% of export proceeds in USD or another convertible currency in its foreign-currency account, or convert any portion to EGP at the prevailing interbank rate at its own discretion. The dealing bank will match each incoming receipt against the customs export declaration and commercial invoice; failure to receive proceeds within the prescribed window must be explained in writing and may trigger CBE reporting, suspension of export financing facilities, or classification of the LLC as a non-performing exporter.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (EGP) / USD Export Proceeds Account
Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account (EGP) / USD Export Proceeds Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium for inbound marketplace payout aggregation; Low for primary treasury or statutory receivables clearing. Legal constraints: (i) CBE Law No. 194 of 2020 and CBE payment-system regulations reserve deposit-taking and payment-account operation in Egypt to licensed banks and licensed fintech institutions; offshore Electronic Money Institutions (Wise, Payoneer, Airwallex, MultiPass, etc.) hold no Egyptian banking license and may not lawfully open EGP-denominated corporate accounts or act as the LLC's principal receipt point for Egyptian export proceeds. (ii) Etsy Direct Pay and Stripe payouts must ultimately settle via SWIFT MT103 into the LLC's USD account at an Egyptian licensed bank; if the marketplace routes via an offshore EMI, the extra intermediary layer triggers third-party-payment AML scrutiny and may be rejected by the receiving bank unless a complete upstream payment-trail dossier is provided. (iii) Recommended posture: use a licensed Egyptian bank as the formal treasury anchor; use offshore EMI only as a temporary collection conduit where the Egyptian bank's compliance officer has pre-approved the arrangement in writing, with mandatory onward clearing to Egypt within 7 business days.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is mandatory for corporate account opening in Egypt. Under the Anti-Money Laundering Law No. 80 of 2002 (as amended), CBE AML/CFT regulations, and EMCLU instructions, at least one authorized signatory — ordinarily the general manager or a resident director of the LLC — must appear personally at the bank's corporate branch for the face-to-face compliance interview, signature specimen verification, and original document inspection. Non-resident shareholders may be represented through a notarized and apostilled power of attorney naming a resident director, but the resident authorized signatory must still attend the interview physically; remote or fully digital corporate onboarding is not permitted. The LLC's commercial registration certificate (Sakkah), tax card, investment certificate (if GAFI-registered), and the original ID/passport of every 25%+ beneficial owner must be produced at the initial meeting.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Complex beneficial-ownership chain with non-resident shareholders or high-risk mainstream-jurisdiction ties.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Signed beneficial-ownership declaration; certified register of members; notarized and apostilled passport copies of all natural-person shareholders; corporate organizational chart; source-of-funds declaration with bank references; certification that no bearer shares exist; the LLC's incorporation contract under Companies Law No. 159 of 1981 (as amended by Law No. 4 of 2018).

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Digital-marketplace receivables (Etsy Direct Pay, Stripe) identified as unexplained third-party or processor payments.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Etsy seller verification page and payout ledger; Stripe settlement statements; marketplace Terms of Service governing the buyer-to-payout flow; reconciliations of each weekly payout to the corresponding export customs declarations (Form 4) and commercial invoices; shipping/tracking evidence for the enamel-pin consignments; anistency memo to the bank's AML unit explaining the low-risk physical-goods e-commerce model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-volume low-value export receipts with deduction-heavy settlement (fees, refunds, chargebacks) creating cash-flow anomalies.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Itemized Etsy/Stripe payout reports showing gross sales, commission, processing fees, and net settlement; ledger of chargebacks/refunds with order IDs; annual reconciliation signed by the external auditor; past three-months bank statements; standard trade documentation package for each delivery batch.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Capital injection from a foreign shareholder in USD without clear CBE FDI purpose code or GAFI notice.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Board/shareholder resolution approving the capital contribution; GAFI investment registration certificate; notarized share-subscription agreement; CBE purpose code 'FDIEQ – Equity subscription' (or bank-designated code); source-of-funds documentation from the remitting bank; LLC commercial registration evidencing authorized capital.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The LLC's foreign shareholder must remit the capital contribution via SWIFT MT103 to the Capital Escrow Account (USD-denominated) or an EGP account opened at the chosen Egyptian bank. The remittance instruction must include: the LLC's exact registered name, the account IBAN, the bank's SWIFT/BIC, and the CBE-approved FDI purpose code (e.g., 'FDIEQ – Equity Investment / Subscription'). The bank will require the following to be presented or pre-uploaded: (i) the LLC's commercial registration and incorporation contract; (ii) a notarized shareholder resolution authorizing the injection; (iii) the GAFI investment notification/certificate under Investment Law No. 72 of 2017; (iv) the CBE capital-inflow monitoring form; (v) the remitting shareholder's bank-reference letter and source-of-funds documentation; (vi) the LLC's current tax card. If the capital is injected in USD and local expenses require EGP, the conversion is executed at the interbank rate on the dealing bank's platform; no parallel market or cash deposit over EGP 250,000 (or equivalent) may be used without full evidenced-source paperwork. The bank will issue a foreign-investment inflow notice that should be retained for future profit repatriation and dividend clearance.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: For procurement of brass blanks, enamel paints, electroplating chemicals, packaging, and US/UK design-tooling services, the LLC shall employ: (i) SWIFT MT103 telegraphic transfers for open-account supplier payments, supported by proforma/commercial invoice, purchase order, and import customs declaration (Form 4) with a CBE import purpose code for raw materials; (ii) sight or usance documentary Letters of Credit (LC) for high-value or first-time overseas suppliers, opened at the dealing bank with a margin of 15%–30% depending on the bank's exposure appetite, with shipping documents (Bill of Lading, packing list, certificate of origin) presented under UCP 600; (iii) documentary collections for moderate-risk counterparties; (iv) EGP-denominated disbursements for local subcontract kilns, plating shops, and logistics via the Egyptian RTGS system (RPS) after converting USD to EGP at the dealing bank's interbank desk; (v) for marketplace-driven B2C shipments (Etsy/Stripe), outbound logistics fees may be paid in USD directly from the USD export-proceeds account to the carrier/forwarder, provided the payment is documented as a trade expense and reconciled against the corresponding sale. All outbound FX payments require the LLC to present the underlying import/evidence package to the bank at the time of instruction, and the bank will validate the counterparty's name against sanctions listings.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable FX Forward (USD/EGP) with a CBE-licensed Egyptian bank, tenor up to 12 months, requiring an underlying export contract, proforma invoice, or commission agreement evidencing trade exposure, booked under CBE derivatives conduct rules.

FX Swap (USD/EGP) executed with the own dealing bank to cover short-term mismatches in export-inflow and import-outflow timing, with rollover subject to bank credit lines and daily margin maintenance.

Cross-Currency Swap (USD vs. EUR/GBP) where Etsy USD payouts hedge against USD-denominated raw-material costs while Stripe EUR/GBP buyer settlements hedge the sales side; bank-approved only with underlying commercial exposure documentation.

Plain-Vanilla FX Options (USD call/put and EGP put/call) purchased for premium with the dealing bank's treasury desk, permissible for hedging confirmed order pipelines in the novelty-manufacturing sector.

Natural hedging via a multi-currency account structure (USD retained for USD-supplier payments; EUR/GBP retained for European/UK marketplace payouts; EGP used only for local statutory cost) to minimize unnecessary conversions.

Onshore NDFs (non-deliverable forwards) are not permissible for Egyptian resident corporates under current CBE practice; only deliverable forwards with a licensed Egyptian counterparty are allowed, and any offshore EGP-USD NDF participation by the LLC is prohibited.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (Form 49) together with audited annual financial statements
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 4 months after the end of the fiscal year; for a calendar-year LLC, no later than 30 April
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Monthly late-filing and late-payment additions under Law No. 91/2005, with the total addition capped at a percentage of the tax due; continued non-compliance triggers interest, enforced administrative collection, loss of ETA tax-clearance certificate, and director or partner personal liability where returns were wilfully omitted.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual commercial-registry renewal of the commercial registration card
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: General Authority for Investment and Free Zones (GAFI) Commercial Registry One-Stop Shop
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal during January of each calendar year; the renewed card is typically required before 31 January
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A late-renewal surcharge is assessed by GAFI for renewals completed after the statutory date; persistent non-renewal beyond the applicable grace period leads to strike-off notices from the Commercial Registry and can result in administrative dissolution under Companies Law No. 159/1981.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual beneficial-owner (UBO) confirmation included in the commercial-registry renewal declaration
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: GAFI Commercial Registry One-Stop Shop, with the UBO file accessible to the Egyptian Money Laundering and Terrorist Financing Combating Unit
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed at the same time as the annual commercial-registry renewal; updated within 30 days of any shareholding transfer or change in beneficial ownership
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Administrative fines under AML Law No. 80/2002 and its executive regulations; the Commercial Registry may refuse to register subsequent transfers, and persons making false UBO declarations face criminal penalties.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Every Egyptian LLC under Companies Law No. 159/1981 must appoint at least one registered statutory auditor; there is no general capital or revenue exemption. The ETA also requires audited financial statements to be annexed to the corporate tax return for LLCs and may accept a certified reviewed accountant statement only for very small taxpayers when an applicable ministerial threshold is explicitly met.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Egyptian Accounting Standards (EAS) issued under Decree No. 110/2015, substantively converged with IFRS; statutory books are kept in Arabic or bilingual Arabic-English form under Law No. 159/1981 and tax-law record-keeping rules.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: The LLC must maintain a written beneficial-ownership register at its registered office. At each annual commercial-registry renewal, the managers confirm and file the current UBO data as at 31 December. Any share transfer or any change in direct or indirect ownership of 25% or more must be recorded in the statutory registers and declared to GAFI/Commercial Registry within 30 days; the annual confirmation is the consolidated declaration required for that period.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Minute Book of General Assembly and Management Resolutions

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 22.5% (Egyptian CIT Law 91/2005 as amended; general rate for limited liability companies)
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Free-zone projects enjoy 0% CIT on qualifying export activity; investment projects under Law 72/2017 may receive a 5-year tax holiday, and certain strategic/export-oriented manufacturers can apply for a 50% reduction on taxable income arising from export revenues (subject to ETA conditions)

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Egyptian Tax Authority Form No. 10 (Corporate Income Tax Return) + TP disclosure form; filed via ETA e-portal at portal.eta.gov.eg (ez-tax portal)
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; preparation of quarterly advance corporate tax prepayments
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 4 months after the fiscal year-end (i.e., 30 April for December-end); no automatic extension, but face-to-face extension by ETA on specific grounds

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name of EG LLC, Egyptian Tax Card number, Tax ID, fiscal year, activity code ISIC 3240 and registered address
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders must disclose their country of residence and any permanent establishment/income registration in Egypt; if no PE, file a limited treaty-protective capacity

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 2 - Gross Receipts and Export Turnover
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross turnover from domestic sales and foreign e-commerce channels (Etsy direct pay and Stripe settlements), plus any export-incentive revenue
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a non-resident LLC, only Egyptian-sourced turnover is reportable; export sales are reportable if performance/receipts flow into Egyptian bank accounts; keep platform settlement statements as reconciliations

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 3 - Cost of Goods Sold & Production Expenses
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Raw brass, hard enamel pigments, die-striking, polishing labor, production overhead, freight/import duties attributable to manufacturing enamel lapel pins
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident entities may claim only costs actually borne by the Egyptian branch/LLC and supported by audited accounts; no arbitrary apportionment of head-office overhead except under DTA business-profits rules

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 4 - Operating Expenses and Tax Deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Marketing, Etsy/Stripe fees, administrative salaries, rents, utilities, depreciation, and statutory loss carryforward deductions
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Etsy/Stripe commissions charged to the Egyptian LLC must be billed by a related or third-party provider at arm's length and be covered by VAT/withholding certificates if intra-group fees are involved

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 5 - Taxable Profit and Tax Rate
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Calculate taxable profit after adjusting for non-deductible payments, applying the 22.5% CIT rate, offsetting quarterly advance payments and withholding credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Foreign shareholders cannot deduct a notional internal profit share; dividend remittances remain subject to 10% WHT and are not expensed by the Egyptian LLC

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirm whether any intra-group transactions with non-residents exceed the filing threshold; attach/tag Local File and Master File in the portal
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident parent entities must ensure the Egyptian LLC's TP disclosure is signed by a local authorized representative and includes a DTA-based business purpose statement

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of Form No. 10: fine of EGP 500 to EGP 5,000 per return, plus a monthly surcharge of 2% of the unpaid CIT for each commenced month of delay; late payment accrues an additional 1.5% per month; persistent non-filing can lead to tax card suspension, mailbox-seizure examination, and criminal tax evasion charges under Law 91/2005 Art. 132 (imprisonment and an EGP 5,000–50,000 fine)

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 10% on dividend distributions to non-residents (and resident shareholders) under Egypt Income Tax Law 91/2005, unless reduced by an applicable DTA (commonly 5%-15%)
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Before payment, the Egyptian LLC and the foreign shareholder file an application with the Egyptian Tax Authority (ETA) using the prescribed WHT relief form, attaching: (i) an in-force Certificate of Tax Residence (TRC) for the immediate shareholder; (ii) legalized English/Arabic translation if required; (iii) a beneficial ownership declaration; and (iv) evidence that the shareholder is the true economic owner and subject to tax in its resident jurisdiction. ETA issues a reduced-rate withholding order; until the order is in hand, domestic 10% WHT must be withheld and paid. Relief applies prospectively and refunds are obtainable if withholding was made in excess.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties for IP and technical assistance: statutory WHT rate 20%, commonly reduced to 10%-15% under Egypt's DTAs. Interest on shareholder/third-party loans: statutory WHT rate 20% on Egyptian-source interest; many Egypt DTAs reduce interest WHT to 5%-15%; certain foreign currency loan interest under Central Bank guarantees may be exempt, subject to strict ETA ruling requirements.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Egyptian Transfer Pricing Guidelines require a contemporaneous Local File where the annual aggregate value of controlled transactions exceeds EGP 8,000,000; a Master File is additionally required for taxpayers belonging to MNE groups with consolidated group turnover above EGP 5,000,000,000 (or where the local file triggers a specific ETA notice). Transactions below EGP 8,000,000 still need an annual TP disclosure form and arm's-length benchmarking at the request of the ETA.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Egypt does not operate a standalone Economic Substance Regulations (ESR) regime; however, the ETA enforces substance-oriented anti-abuse rules: DTAs are applied only where the recipient has substantive business activity, real premises, personnel, and spontaneous beneficial-owner documentation. A pure shell holding or conduit outside Egypt is disregarded for treaty relief and may be ignored for corporate/TP purposes, causing the profits to be re-attributed to the Egyptian industrial permanent establishment.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax evasion through under-declared digital sales
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Separating Etsy/Stripe proceeds from the Egyptian LLC’s books or under-reporting cross-border e-commerce sales to the ETA while the banking records and payment-platform statements show higher revenue.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal prosecution under Law 91/2005 Art. 132: imprisonment up to 5 years and a fine of EGP 5,000 to EGP 50,000, plus civil assessment of the full evaded tax, a 2% monthly delay fine and, in aggravated cases, an equalization surcharge of up to 100% of the tax defect.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Managing directors and signatories who materially participated in the false filing are co-defendants; the ETA may obtain freezing orders on personal assets, travel bans, and police removal from office pending trial, and the liability tracker can continue against directors after liquidation.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Interposing a zero-tax, substance-less offshore entity (or an Egyptian LLC without employees, inventory, or operational decisions) as the nominal shareholder solely to invoke a lower treaty WHT rate on dividends from the enamel pin manufacturing company.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Denial of treaty claim; reclassification of dividends to 10% domestic WHT (or, under substance-over-form theory, full 22.5% corporate tax on the profit distribution); addition of EGP 10,000-100,000 penalty for false statement in a taxpayer registration or return, and potential AML prosecution for asset hiding.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Where corporate separateness is algorithmic sham, the court may pierce the veil and make the offshore beneficial owners and founding directors jointly liable for the underpaid Egyptian CIT and WHT, plus asset confiscation and denial of future business licenses; directors face a personal travel ban until the tax arrear is settled.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Manipulative transfer pricing and missing TP file
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failing to file the mandatory TP disclosure, or shifting more than normal profits to a related foreign sales company through overpriced free-zone services, unreasonable commissions, or non-existent technical royalties, all while failing to document the economic substance of the transaction.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: ETA transfer pricing adjustment: profits reallocated to the Egyptian LLC and taxed at 22.5%; plus 2% monthly delay surcharge, an administrative penalty of up to EGP 2 million for non-submission/ false TP documentation, and, in intentional cases, a fine equal to 100% of the adjusted tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who prepare/approve the TP file are jointly and severally liable for evaded tax if they knowingly relied on false intercompany agreements or failed to release the Egyptian company from non-arm's-length margins; civil penalization includes disqualification from serving as directors and seizure of director bank balances.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: AML / financial crime arising from low-risk digital export collections
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Unjustified refusal to produce beneficial owner/anti-money laundering due-diligence for the EG LLC's shareholder structure, accepting undocumented payments in cash or cryptocurrencies, or using personal bank accounts to receive Etsy/Stripe business proceeds from high-risk customers while evading corporate tax and customs declarations.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Violations of Egypt Law 80/2002 on Anti-Money Laundering: imprisonment from 2 to 7 years and fines from EGP 100,000 to EGP 1,000,000; independent case under CIT where undeclared income is confiscated; bank accounts and merchant terminals are immediately suspended.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, compliance officers, and ultimate beneficial owners can be prosecuted individually; punishments include forfeiture of assets, freezing of personal bank accounts, travel bans, and director disqualification for up to 10 years; statutory auditors also face liability if they certified misleading financial statements.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Unlawful dividend remittance without WHT / treaty procedure
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Repatriating profits of the EG LLC to its foreign parent through intercompany loan repayments, arbitrary dividends, or clearing-account credits without operating a 10% dividend WHT account and without first obtaining the ETA WHT relief order under the reconcilable treaty.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Company is treated as an unfaithful withholding agent: aggressive recovery of the full 10% WHT not withheld plus a fine of 200% of that amount, 2% monthly delay penalty, and denial of treaty benefits for future distributions; directors may be barred from foreign exchange release approvals.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Corporate officers who order overseas remittances will be jointly and severally liable for the unremitted WHT; Egyptian authorities may issue administrative attachment against personal and real estate assets of directors and impose a ban on travel/discretionary foreign transfers until restitution.
